events.text: House rule: once a wedding-day schedule has been confirmed with the couple, no timing on it may be changed without the couple's written OK. Always ask them first.
House rule: any supplier order over 1000 needs Theo's sign-off before it is sent to the supplier.
Confirming Rosehill Barn is booked for the Hartley wedding on 17 October 2026, with supplier access from 07:00 and the ceremony room ready by 14:00.
Ben and I are delighted to confirm the Hartley wedding for Saturday 17 October 2026 at Rosehill Barn, 56 guests, with Everly Events running the day.
Quote for the Hartley wedding: three-course wedding breakfast for 56 guests at 68 per head, total 3808, valid for 60 days.

Flower plan for the Hartley wedding at Rosehill Barn on 17 October 2026: bridal bouquet, six table centres and ceremony urns in a dusty-pink dahlia and garden rose palette, total 1240. We will deliver to the barn at 08:00 on the morning of the wedding.
For the Hartley wedding I can start whenever suits. I need about 30 minutes for detail shots of the flowers and table styling before guests are around.
Bridal hair and makeup for Nora will take about 90 minutes start to finish; happy to work around your morning schedule.

Placed the Lilybank Blooms order for the Hartley wedding: dusty-pink dahlia and garden rose flowers, 1240, delivered to Rosehill Barn at 08:00 on 17 October 2026. Theo countersigned as it is over 1000.

Booked Kim Aldero to start detail shots of the flowers and styling at 08:30 on 17 October 2026, straight after the Lilybank delivery lands at the barn at 08:00, giving her the 30 minutes she asked for before the morning gets busy.

Sent the Hartleys their confirmed wedding-day morning timeline: flowers at 08:00, Kim's detail photography at 08:30, then Thea starting Nora's 90-minute hair and makeup at 09:45 once the detail shots wrap. Nora replied in writing that they are happy with it.
Ordered dusty-pink linen for the eight guest tables from Hartfield Hire to match the dahlia and garden rose palette in the Lilybank flower plan.
Chased Hartfield Hire on the linen quote turnaround; they say delivery slots for mid-October are filling up.
Deposit invoice for the Hartley wedding flowers: 372 payable by 15 August, balance on delivery.
Booked Fairway Catering for the Hartley wedding: three-course wedding breakfast for 56 guests at 68 per head, total 3808.
For the Okafor wedding on 21 November we will deliver to the Orchard Room at 08:00 sharp; the couple asked for a white and green palette.
Theo paid the Lilybank deposit of 372 today; receipt filed.
Quick note: I will bring a second shooter for the Hartley wedding from the ceremony onwards, no change to the morning plan.
Catch-up with Theo: final numbers for the Hartleys confirmed at 56, menu tasting done, linen due to arrive 16 October.

Small logistics update on the Hartley wedding: our van route that Saturday has changed, so the earliest we can get the flowers to Rosehill Barn on 17 October is 10:00. The flowers themselves, the dusty-pink palette and the 1240 total all stay exactly as agreed.
Just checking everything is on track for the 17th — Ben's mother keeps asking what time she should arrive!
Reminder to myself: send Kim Aldero her final confirmed timings for the Hartley wedding by Friday 9 October.
